architecture_contract.address_arithmetic: All base, offset, scale, and update arithmetic is modulo 2^64. PC-relative forms align TPC down to four bytes before adding the four-byte-scaled displacement.
architecture_contract.pair_completion: Both original addresses preflight before either architectural element commits. The first failing original address is reported and restart is full reissue.
architecture_contract.permission_fault: PTO v0 identity translation has no translation-fault outcome. Permission and bounded-memory failures both report Fault_DataPage.
architecture_contract.prefetch: Every model value is legal portable hint metadata. Prefetch forms an address but performs no translation, permission check, event, reservation, or memory effect; address-returning forms publish the formed address.
architecture_contract.reg5_order: All sources are snapshotted before effects. Pair destinations write in encoded order; repeated GPR or queue destinations therefore retain that order.
architecture_contract.writeback: Pre-index accesses the updated address, post-index accesses the original base, and writeback publishes only after successful completion. Decoded pairs have no writeback mode.

independent_comparison.pto_disposition: The independent executable ISA/model comparison corroborates shared address formation, modifier, indexing, width, and prefetch rules. PTO keeps transactional pair preflight and genuinely unscaled UPR/UPO store writeback as explicit PTO-owned behavior. PTO-native evidence remains authoritative for Reg5 queues, events, permission faults, traps, and restart.
